blocks.text:
Government Central Press, Gandhinagar.
89-2 
GUJARAT GOVERNMENT GAZETTE, EX., 27-07-2026 
 [ PART  I-A 
1. 
(1) 
These rules may be called the Extension Officer, Class-III (Panchayat)/Taluka Panchayat Officer/ 
Extension Officer (Agriculture)/Extension Officer (Co-operation) (Panchayat Service) Lower Level 
Departmental Examination (Amendment) Rules, 2026.     
(2) 
They shall come into force on the date of their publication in Official Gazette. 
2. 
In the Extension Officer, Class-III (Panchayat)/Taluka Panchayat Officer/ Extension Officer (Agriculture)/ 
Extension Officer (Co-operation) (Panchayat Service) Lower Level Departmental Examination Rules, 2009, rule 
8(A) shall be deleted.  
By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat, 
VARSHA C. HERMA, 
Deputy Secretary to Government. 
---------- 
Signed by : BHOLUSINGH G THAKUR
Senior Manager
Government Central Press,
Gandhinagar
Date : 2026.08.04 10:10:01 IST
Signature Not Verified
